title: Pokemon TCG Leafeon Evolutions 005/131 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Leafeon 005/131 Holo card from the Prismatic Evolutions set of the Pokémon TCG is a highly sought-after collectible for fans of the game. This speciality EX card features the character Leafeon in a unique Holo finish, making it a rare find for collectors. Manufactured by The Pokémon Company in the United States, this English-language card is a valuable addition to any Pokémon TCG collection, perfect for players aged 6 and above. With its abnormal Creature/Monster Type and colourless Attribute, this Leafeon card is a standout piece for fans of the game.
